name: github-gist-api-automation
description: API test automation suite for the GitHub Gists REST API (Playwright + TypeScript)

scripts.test: npm run clean:allure --silent && tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts --before && playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:allure --silent && tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts --before && playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean:allure --silent && tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts --before && playwright test --grep "@P0|@P1"
scripts.test:contract: npm run clean:allure --silent && tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts --before && playwright test --grep @contract
scripts.test:security: npm run clean:allure --silent && tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts --before && playwright test --grep @security
scripts.allure:generate: tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-report',{recursive:true,force:true})" && allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --name "GitHub Gists API"
scripts.allure:serve: tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts && allure serve allure-results --name "GitHub Gists API"
scripts.allure:single: tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-report',{recursive:true,force:true})" && allure awesome allure-results --single-file -o allure-report --name "GitHub Gists API"
scripts.allure:ci: tsx scripts/rate-limit-report.ts && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-report',{recursive:true,force:true})" && allure awesome allure-results --history-path allure-history.jsonl -o allure-report --name "GitHub Gists API"
